articles.summary: Download PDF Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULCC), parent company of Frontier Airlines, Inc. , will be releasing its third quarter 2025 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, November 5, 2025 . Management will host a live webcast with analysts to discuss these results the same day at 4:30pm ET .
